index.meta_description: Casia Vacanze - Authentic rest in the Piedmontese countryside. Holiday home in Santo Stefano, Bene Vagienna (Cuneo).
index.og_description: Authentic rest in the Piedmontese countryside. A historic farmhouse carefully restored.
index.hero_title: Authentic rest in the Piedmontese countryside
index.intro_text: In the heart of the Cuneo hills, Casia Vacanze is a peaceful retreat where time slows down. A historic farmhouse carefully restored, blending the charm of traditional Piedmontese architecture with contemporary comfort.
index.appartamenti_intro: Two independent apartments, each with its own character and story. Both with private entrance, garden and pool access.
index.oliva_description: On the first floor of the farmhouse, the Oliva apartment welcomes you with its luminous spaces and original exposed beams. Perfect for couples or small families seeking the comfort of a true Piedmontese home.
index.venica_description: On the ground floor with direct garden access, the Venica apartment is currently being renovated. It will soon be ready to welcome you with refreshed interiors and every modern comfort.
index.venica_coming_note: Available from Summer 2026 — Contact us for details
index.cascina_subtitle: A corner of Piedmont all to yourselves, where the warm hues of the facade greet every arrival
index.service_kitchen_desc: Refrigerator, coffee machine, toaster and kettle
index.service_linen_desc: Quality bed linen and towels included
index.service_pool_desc: Private 8x4 metre pool for a refreshing dip
index.service_bbq_desc: Fully equipped BBQ area in the garden
index.territorio_intro: Casia Vacanze is the ideal starting point for exploring the wonders of southern Piedmont, from historic villages and prestigious vineyards to enchanting landscapes.
index.luogo_bene_desc: A Roman-era village with the archaeological remains of Augusta Bagiennorum, including the theatre and baths of the ancient city
index.luogo_langhe_desc: A short drive away, the UNESCO heritage lands of Barolo, white truffle and fine wines
index.luogo_mare_desc: The Ligurian Riviera is less than an hour's drive away, perfect for a day of sun and beach
index.luogo_montagna_desc: Prato Nevoso and Limone Piemonte within easy reach, for skiing in winter and hiking in summer
index.esp_tartufo_desc: A morning immersed in the Langhe woodlands, accompanied by an expert truffle hunter and his faithful dog. You will discover the secrets of this ancient tradition and, with a little luck, take home your own precious find.
index.esp_auto_desc: Organised group rides for lovers of two and four wheels: scenic routes across the Langhe and Roero, gentle bends, villages and tasty stops, together with people who know every road. Not a rental: a ride among friends.
index.esperienze_note: Contact us to arrange your bespoke experience
index.prenota_intro: Choose your dates, check availability in real time and book in just a few steps.
index.booking_summary_empty: Select dates to see the price
index.prenota_fallback: Prefer to get in touch directly?

amici.meta_description: Casia Vacanze - A real farmhouse in Piedmont where you can actually switch off. No frills, just peace.
amici.og_description: A real farmhouse in Piedmont where you can actually switch off.
amici.hero_title: That countryside house you've been looking for
amici.intro_text: You know when you say "that's it, I need to get away"? Well, Casia is that place. A hundred-year-old farmhouse, done up properly, in the middle of the hills. Nothing fake, nothing built for tourists. Just a real house where your phone barely gets signal and honestly, that's perfect.
amici.appartamenti_intro: There are two, separate, each with its own door and its own bit of garden. You won't bump into anyone if you don't want to. And the pool's right there for everyone.
amici.oliva_description: First floor. Real exposed beams (not the fake IKEA kind), light pouring in from everywhere, and that kind of silence you totally forget about in the city. Perfect for two, or four if you don't mind squeezing onto the sofa bed.
amici.oliva_feat_kitchen: Kitchen with everything (even a moka pot)
amici.oliva_feat_sofa: Living room with a sofa that turns into a bed
amici.oliva_feat_ac: Air conditioning (you'll need it in summer)
amici.oliva_feat_tv: TV (but turn it off once in a while)
amici.venica_description: Ground floor, step outside and you're in the garden. We're fixing it up right now — builders, painters, the usual chaos. But when it's done it'll be amazing. Trust us.
amici.venica_feat_garden: Step outside and you're on the lawn
amici.venica_coming_note: Summer 2026, fingers crossed. Drop us a line if you want to know how it's going.
amici.cascina_subtitle: What you see in the photos is exactly what you get. No filters, no tricks. It's just like that.
amici.service_wifi_desc: It's there, it works. For emergencies.
amici.service_kitchen_desc: Fridge, stove, moka pot, the lot. You can actually cook here.
amici.service_parking_desc: On the property, no pay-and-display nonsense.
amici.service_garden_desc: Grass, trees, silence. Your own bit of outdoors.
amici.service_pool_desc: 8x4 metres, not Olympic-sized but you'll love it.
amici.service_pets_desc: Small ones, well-behaved. No Great Danes.
amici.territorio_intro: We're in the Cuneo area, just below the Langhe. Translation: great wine everywhere, truffles in season, hills that look like paintings. And nobody hassling you.
amici.luogo_bene_desc: The village right down the road. There was a Roman city here, you can still see the ruins. Lovely to walk around.
amici.luogo_langhe_desc: Half an hour and you're where they make Barolo. Wineries, restaurants, sunsets. That whole thing.
amici.luogo_mare_desc: Liguria's less than an hour away. If you fancy the beach, go and be back for dinner.
amici.luogo_montagna_desc: Prato Nevoso and Limone Piemonte are right there. Skiing, walks, fresh air.
amici.esp_tartufo_desc: A local guy takes you into the woods with his dog. You hunt truffles for a couple of hours, learn how it all works, and if you find something you take it home. It's one of those experiences you end up telling everyone about.
amici.esp_auto_desc: Into bikes or beautiful cars? We organise group rides on the Langhe and Roero roads. No rentals: we set off together, we ride, we stop somewhere good to eat. That's it.
amici.esperienze_note: You don't have to do anything at all. Lying on the lawn with a book is perfectly fine.
amici.prenota_intro: Check if your dates are free, pick them and book. Easy.
